summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the format entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when buffered and False otherwise. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) for the new type. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests were added to test_control.py, test_console.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Per instructions, nothing was run and no commits were made; verification was by reading only.
